name: Enemy Posture System - POST05 selective reaction suppression, Red/Black RB (TEST)
author: Dusklight community mods
description: PRIVATE TEST. POST05 0.5.2 (POST05-RB): everything of 0.5.1 (E_OC / Blue solo and group: an ordinary non-lethal sword hit during ATTACK 0/1/2 below the posture threshold no longer starts the DAMAGE flinch; the final setActionMode(DAMAGE) of damage_check is undone by restoring the three mode fields). New: the same suppression for E_OC2 (native Red, Bokoblin Expansion Red, Black 3/3 and fury 6/6), only in a native phase read in that call: a mature B/C swing (clip frame >= 2, native clip end 42/47, rate 1/1.15/2, not stopping) or ATTACK 0 braking that cannot start the clip this tick. The swing start tick, the frame 1->2 tick, the clip end and the guard recoil stay vanilla. HP, hit SE, hit-stop, cooldown and all other reactions stay vanilla. One PRE+POST hook, PRE always continues. Replaces POST05 0.5.1/0.5.0 and POST04/03.1/03/02/01: never load them together. Human Windows DX12 validation pending.
